notes.title: Update #9
notes.notes:

- Weekly leaderboards
- All menus can now be navigated by spectators outside the headset
- Performance optimizations

Bugfixes:

- Fixed a bug in singleplayer with powerup switching

Enjoy!

Cyberpong Dev Team

notes.title: Update #8
notes.notes:
Hey Cyberpongers,

Another update here for you! We've added tools for you to help demo Cyberpong to your friends in our new spectator UI. We've also added  language settings to our options menu. 

Update Details

Additions:
- Added GUI for spectators to navigate menus with from outside the hmd
- Added ability to change player name from outside the hmd
- Added multiple score display modes for spectators
- Added language setting to in-game options
- Added Chinese translation
- Added updated art for Singleplayer paddles
- Added animations to in-game menu buttons

Changes:
- Sharpened text in menus
- Completed support for tournament mode

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bug caused by entering workshop menu and leaving
- Fixed bug with character select

Keep sending us all of your great feedback!

-Cyberpong Dev Team

notes.title: Update #6!
notes.notes:
Hey Cyberpongers!

The next update is out and we’re introducing a new feature! The Cyberpong Level Editor! Create waves of your own design and rise to popularity with fun, challenging and interesting waves. Then share your wondrous creations on the Steam workshop for your fellow Cyberpongers to enjoy. 

To access the level editor, right click " Cyberpong VR " in the steam library window and click 'Launch Game Editor'

We've also added a Multiplayer match notifier to our Single Player mode, that allows you to pause your single player game and join someone waiting in the multiplayer lobby. 

For anyone playing on LAN with friends there is now a quick rematch button to keep the games going! 

Detailed instructions will be coming soon on how to create a level!

notes.title: Update #6
notes.notes:
Hey Cyberpongers,

We have a level editor with Steam Workshop integration coming soon!

We've also made the following improvements as requested by the community:
- Fixed issues joining multiplayer games
- Added options menu with SFX and music volume controls
- Improved collision accuracy on Max's paddles
- Improved performance when a large number of orbs are on screen
- We now store user preferences for spectator cameras

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
Hey Cyberpongers,

We have a quick update here for you. 

* We've heard that a couple people were having difficulty with selecting the powerups with the touchpad so we made it a little easier by increasing the area the touchpad responds to. 

* Spectator cameras are now turned on by default

* We also fixed a bug in multiplayer where the ball was reversing trajectory in certain instances. 

We'll have more updates for you soon!

Adjusted ball physics to be faster and more accurate
Added option to choose your international matchmaking server
Max's paddles are now wider
Fixed issue with pause menu in Training mode
Fixed issue with other player could interfere with ball serving in multiplayer

Added training cards (in review)
